text: Frederick the Great, King of Prussia, loved his greyhounds more than most people.
He asked to be buried next to them, on the terrace of his palace.
Instead, his nephew buried him in a church.
Then a war moved him to a mine. Then another church. Then a castle.
In nineteen ninety-one, two hundred and five years late, he finally got his spot. Right next to the dogs.
People still leave potatoes on his grave. Long story.
Some friends are worth the wait. Jenny on Feeloy won't make you wait.
